g.text: VALHEIM COASTAL MEGA-BASE — MASTER SITE PLAN (CONCEPT A: SEAWARD AXIAL FORUM)
Authoritative 2D Technical Layout | Module: 4.0 m × 4.0 m Grausten Floor Grid | Origin (0, 0, 0): SW Corner of 24 × 24 m Dreamhouse
Fixed Elevations Preserved: Ground Level Z = 0.0 m • Elevated Outdoor Plaza (36 × 36 m) Z = +2.0 m • Dreamhouse Main Floor (24 × 24 m) Z = +4.0 m • Sea Level Z = -1.5 m
Scale: 1 : 100 Metric (1 Grid Square = 4 m × 4 m)
ZONE E: SHELTERED HARBOR BASIN (36m × 20m, Seabed Z = -4.5m)
OVERALL SETTLEMENT WIDTH: 128.0 m (32 × 4m Grausten Tiles) [X = -44m to +84m]
Harbor Basin & Main Quay: 36.0 m (9 Tiles) [X = -8m..+28m]
1 Grid Cell = 4.0 m × 4.0 m (1 Grausten Floor 4×4 Tile)
Z = +4.0 m : Dreamhouse Main Floor & Resting Hall
24×24m House + 4m Skybridge + 16×16m Resting Hall (4m Basement below)
Z = +2.0 m : First Outdoor Elevated Plaza & Spa Court
36×36m Fixed Plaza (X: -4..32m, Y: -8..28m) + West Hot Tub Terrace
Z = 0.0 m : Primary Ground Datum, Avenues, Quay & Farms
King's Way Avenue, 8m Ring Road, Harbor Quay, Agriculture & Husbandry
Z = -1.5 m Waterline | Z = -2.0 m Lox Pit | Z = -4.5 m Basin
1.5m Quay Freeboard; 3.0m Clear Water Draft for Longship / Drakkar
Verified 4×4×0.5m Ashstone tier (Support 100–2000, rain-immune). All major zones,
plazas, and 8m avenues snap to integer multiples of 4.0m from Origin (0,0).
• Primary Structural & Facade Identity (Darkwood + Black Marble):
Black Marble plinths, retaining walls (+2m Plaza, +4m House basement) & quay coping
paired with Darkwood 2m/4m beams, arches, carved dividers, and tarred Shingle Roofs.
(Note: Vanilla Darkwood has no solid wall tiles; infill uses Black Marble / Ashwood).
4× 12×12m soil beds leave raw cultivated earth with zero roof overhang (1.0m crop
spacing; 3.6m Vineberry spacing along East wall). Lox/Asksvin pit uses indestructible
earth-core retaining walls at Z = -2.0m within 64m active breeding range of House.
